summary: Allow SQLite WAL restart during mail objective captures and resolve distinct identities once per capture

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Mail acceptance, unknown coverage and source freshness semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Mail-delivery objectives read retained source metadata in indexed 128-row pages without a scan-wide snapshot, allowing WAL restart during capture. Canonical identity references are resolved once per distinct spelling within each capture. Input-scoped native notifications replace global wake coalescing; there is no cooldown. Pending relevant changes and overlapping mail-input cuts publish unknown coverage rather than certifying stale or mixed observations. Idle heartbeat and lifecycle boundary timers remain active.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on daemon restart; no migration required.
